name: Revisions ES module outputs — atomic LFS hydration and bounded durable close; measured 108425 bytes brotli on macOS, 2026-10-21; cross-device chat handoff (XD3/XD4: a chat's checkout resolved from its branch and opened on demand, removed checkouts remembered on the device, and the turn-placement `publish` verb for a live run's heartbeat) about 0.9 kB, 109.32 kB brotli on Linux, 2026-10-23, then 109.42 kB with a missing branch waited on only while a remote syncs and an atomic removed-checkout record (limit raised from 108.6 kB to 109.6 kB with the owner's approval), then 109.70 kB brotli on Linux, 2026-10-23, with a branch a pull deletes recorded removed, a replayed admission answered before placement work, and a bounded wait for a branch's checkout to open (limit raised from 109.6 kB to 110.0 kB with the owner's approval); main's git HTTP client retry of 429 and retryable 503 (Hosted Remote Storage DA6) about 0.6 kB (about 109.0 kB on Linux CI on main, 2026-10-24); 110.23 kB brotli on Linux after merging main, 2026-10-24 (limit raised from 110.0 kB to 110.5 kB under the owner's standing revisions approval); the chat's record device id exposed to the host so external-agent markers stamp the id the chat segments sync under rather than hostname:username (which must not leave the host, EQ10(a)), about 17 bytes (limit raised from 110.5 kB to 110.6 kB with the owner's approval, 2026-10-25); the save path (push lag dated at push start, one push advertisement per attempt with stale refusals mapped to leaseLost, and a bounded parallel LFS upload pool) about 0.66 kB (111.26 kB on Linux CI, 2026-10-29; limit raised from 110.6 kB to 111.5 kB under the owner's standing revisions approval)
